bio_am: Ծնած է Թաւրիզ՝ 1876-ին։ 1903-1908 Վասպուրականի յեղափոխական գործի ղեկավար, մահացած է Պէյրութ՝ 1973-ին։
bio_en: Vahan Papazian, known as Koms and also 'Bzhishk', was born in Tabriz in January 1876, lost his father in Salmast at nine and lived with his sister in Tiflis until 1893. In 1895 he worked briefly with the Hnchaks in New Nakhichevan, then joined the ARF in Alexandropol; he studied in Moscow and St Petersburg with Nikol Aghbalian until 1902 and was in Geneva until June 1903. When the church properties were seized he went to Vaspurakan with Vana Ishkhan and led the revolutionary work there from 1903 to 1908, guiding young fighters such as Vahe Artsruni. For sixty years, with gun and pen, he served the Armenian cause as party leader and memoirist, and he died in Beirut on 1 October 1973.
